title: Job-readiness Training at Day Activity Centres
what_it_is: Job-readiness Training at Day Activity Centres

sections.label: Day Activity Centres support
sections.summary: Day Activity Centres provide long-term care support for persons with disabilities with no or low work capability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For example, Day Activity Centres (DACs) provide long-term care support for persons with disabilities with no or low work capability.

sections.label: Sheltered Workshops job training
sections.summary: Sheltered Workshops provide job training and self-enrichment programmes for adults with disabilities who may not be work-ready or unable to work in open employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: On the other hand, Sheltered Workshops provide job training and self-enrichment programmes to support adults with disabilities who may not be work-ready or who are unable to work in an open employment setting.

sections.label: Special Employment Credit wage offset
sections.summary: Employers hiring Singaporean workers with disabilities earning up to $4,000 a month receive the Special Employment Credit, a wage offset of up to 16% of monthly salary for employees aged below 67.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To encourage employers to hire Singaporean workers with disabilities, employers who employ such workers earning up to $4,000 a month receive the Special Employment Credit (SEC) that provides a wage offset of up to 16% of monthly salary for employees aged below 67, that is to say, for those who are aged below 67, the employers can get the wage offset of up to 16% of the monthly salary.

sections.label: RISE Mentorship and IHL internship
sections.summary: RISE Mentorship matches students with disabilities with business leaders, IHL internship matches students with inclusive organisations, and MSF and SG Enable will continue improving care through Enabling Masterplan programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The RISE Mentorship matches students with disabilities with business leaders from corporates, multinational corporations and other inclusive employers; while the IHL internship matches students with well-established and inclusive organisations in various sectors based on their course of study, interests and preferences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister of Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: So, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) and SG Enable will continue to improve the care and support to persons with disabilities together with our partners in the people and private sector through the implementation of the Enabling Masterplan programmes.

sections.label: DAC and Workshop opening days
sections.summary: Day Activity Centres and Sheltered Workshops are open Mondays to Fridays and welcome all eligible participants able to take advantage of their programmes and facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: For the first question, our DACs and Sheltered Workshops are open from Mondays to Fridays and they welcome all eligible participants who are able to take advantage of the programmes and services to make use of the centres' programmes and facilities.

sections.label: Enabling Masterplan 3 workgroups
sections.summary: Under the Enabling Masterplan 3, three different, separate workgroups were set up to focus on different areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Under the Enabling Masterplan 3 (EMP3), we set up three different, separate workgroups to focus on different areas.

sections.label: Preparing young children for employment
sections.summary: Preparing young children for future employment is a very important prerequisite, and another EMP3 workgroup focuses on improving employment opportunities and prospects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: It is a very important prerequisite to prepare young children for future employment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: There is another workgroup under EMP3 which focuses on the improvement to employment opportunities and prospects.

sections.label: Sheltered Workshops places and capacity
sections.summary: A question asks how many Sheltered Workshops exist and their capacity, and the reply states there are sufficient places in the Sheltered Workshops.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My question is, how many Sheltered Workshops do we have and what is the capacity?

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: We have sufficient places in our Sheltered Workshops.
